answer: Sybil resistance follows from aggregating correlated equivocation across k identities: penalties scale as k² and are debited from bonded collateral, rather than assessed as isolated key-level faults. On detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies across the swarm; asymmetric depreciation and vault-held escrow prevent simple recovery by re-registration, while a cipher commitment and ivory audit record make attribution and forfeiture verifiable.
